description: Maximum number of active nodes in the content cluster during the test window.
Fraction of content-cluster nodes that are not yet active, indicating an in-progress resize or data redistribution.
Number of autoscaler rescale actions taken for the content cluster during the test window.
Ratio of peak to ideal CPU load for the content cluster; above 1.0 signals scale-up pressure and below 1.0 signals the cluster is over-provisioned for CPU.
The autoscaler's ideal CPU load target for the content cluster, as a percentage (already includes growth and failover headroom, so normally below 100).
Ratio of the content cluster's query rate during the test window to its own trailing 3-hour average, a proxy for the autoscaler's internal query-growth headroom factor.
Query rate for the content cluster, one half of the query/write mix that determines the autoscaler's ideal CPU target.
Write rate (put + update + remove operations per second) for the content cluster, the other half of the query/write mix that determines the autoscaler's ideal CPU target.
